description:
Compute quantitative risk and threat assessment for candidate actions, plans, or 3D spatial rollouts against active utility weights (actions: action, plan, compare, spatial_rollout). Use assess_risk instead of evaluate_situation when estimating failure probability and threat exposure rather than ranking overall utility.

Returns risk score (0.0-1.0), threat breakdown, and comparative risk ratings.

action.description: Risk assessment mode: action, plan, compare, spatial_rollout

candidate_actions.description: Multiple actions to compare risk scores

trajectory.description: Array of [x, y, z] waypoints for spatial rollout risk assessment

name: assess_risk
